subject: English
passage: When a given sector—telecommunications and banking are two prominent examples—involves significant regulatory requirements and other constraints that limit new entrants, ______ of just one or two dominant firms per region. Such sectors are known as oligopolies.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice B is the best answer. The convention being tested is pronoun-antecedent agreement. The singular pronoun "it" agrees in number with the singular antecedent "sector" and clearly indicates that the sector consists of just one or two dominant firms per region.
